user.title: Presence Simulator
user.description: Configure the lights used for presence simulation.

data_description.lights: Select the lights that may be controlled by the simulator.

init.title: Activity window
init.description: Choose how Presence Simulator determines when activity is allowed.

fixed.title: Fixed time window
fixed.description: Configure the daily time window in which presence simulation may run.

data_description.fixed_start_time: Time when simulated activity may begin.
data_description.fixed_end_time: Time when simulated activity must stop. Overnight ranges are supported.
data_description.fixed_weekdays: Select the days on which this activity window is enabled.

sun.title: Sun-based window
sun.description: Configure the activity window relative to sunrise or sunset.

data_description.sun_start_event: Choose sunrise or sunset as the start reference.
data_description.sun_start_offset_minutes: Offset in minutes. Negative values start before the selected event.
data_description.sun_end_event: Choose sunrise or sunset as the end reference.
data_description.sun_end_offset_minutes: Offset in minutes. Positive values end after the selected event.

activity.title: Simulation behaviour
activity.description: Configure the lights and random activity timings.

data_description.lights: Select the lights that may be controlled by Presence Simulator.
data_description.min_initial_delay_minutes: Minimum delay before each light's first possible activity when the window opens.
data_description.max_initial_delay_minutes: Maximum delay before each light's first possible activity when the window opens.
data_description.min_on_minutes: Minimum time a simulated light remains ON.
data_description.max_on_minutes: Maximum time a simulated light remains ON.
data_description.min_off_minutes: Minimum waiting time before that light may become active again.
data_description.max_off_minutes: Maximum waiting time before that light may become active again.
data_description.max_simultaneous: Maximum number of simulated lights that may be ON at the same time.

error.min_on_greater_than_max: Minimum ON time cannot be greater than maximum ON time.
error.min_off_greater_than_max: Minimum OFF time cannot be greater than maximum OFF time.
error.min_initial_delay_greater_than_max: Minimum initial delay cannot be greater than maximum initial delay.
